scenes.title: A day as the accountant
scenes.subtitle: Vikram keeps the books straight
scenes.narration: Vikram handles accounts. He invoices, records what comes in and pays suppliers, without asking sales for anything.
First the overdue invoices, sorted so the oldest and largest are on top.
The receivables report breaks what is owed into age bands, customer by customer.
A bank transfer has arrived. He records it against the invoice with the bank reference.
New invoices pick their HSN and SAC codes from a built-in library, so the GST is right first time.
Then supplier payments: he records what was paid to the houseboat company, and their ledger updates.

scenes.headline: Books that keep themselves straight.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Books that keep themselves straight.
